title: An honouring name and a proud response
odia:
ଛୋଟୀ କି ଶ୍ରୀବନ୍ତୀ କହିଲେ
ଗୋଡକୁ ବୁଲାଇ ପକାଏ।
literal_meaning: Call a woman who limps “Sribanti”—an honoured lady—and she swings her leg around.
meaning_odia: ଛୋଟୀକୁ ଶ୍ରୀବନ୍ତୀ କହିବାମାତ୍ରେ ସେ ଗୋଡ଼ ବୁଲାଇ ପକାଉଛି—ଏହା ଢଗର ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗଚିତ୍ର। ମିଳୁଥିବା ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ପାଠର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ସମ୍ମାନ ପାଇ ଗର୍ବରେ ପୂରିଉଠିବାକୁ ଏହାର ଅର୍ଥ କହେ। ଏଠାରେ ସମ୍ମାନସୂଚକ କଥା ଶୁଣି ଆତ୍ମଗର୍ବ ବଢ଼ିବାର ଭାବକୁ ବୁଝାଯାଉଛି; ଚାଲିବାରେ ଅସୁବିଧା ଥିବାକୁ ଅଯୋଗ୍ୟତା ଭାବେ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରାଯାଉନାହିଁ।
explanation: An honouring address is followed by a conspicuous movement of the leg. The inspected public counterpart glosses the scene as pride produced by honour the speaker considers misplaced. The useful distinction is between receiving respectful words and becoming self-important; the source’s disability-based caricature is not a judgment about disabled people’s worth.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A beginner receives an extravagant introduction at a meeting and immediately starts ordering experienced colleagues about. The comparison concerns the inflated response to praise, without applying the source’s bodily insult to the person.
cultural_context: The public counterpart calls the woman ଗୋଦରୀ, while the upload uses ଛୋଟୀ. Both construct their ridicule through a woman’s leg. The change in disability term is recorded openly; the shared sequence is an honouring address followed by a gesture the source treats as pride.

witnesses.locator: Page20, second item beginning ଛୋଟୀ କି.
witnesses.note: Rendered upload inspected 17 November 2026. Exact spelling and spacing retained, including separate କି and ଗୋଡକୁ.

Counterpart reads ଗୋଦରୀକି ଶ୍ରୀବନ୍ତୀ (ଶ୍ରୀମତୀ) କହିଲେ ସେ ଗୋଡ଼ ବୁଲେଇ ପକାଏ. Different disability term and verb/object wording; upload preserved. Public gloss attributes pride to honour given to one the source labels unworthy; that label is not editorial endorsement.

origin_note: Uploaded wording has a public counterpart with a different disability term and minor grammatical differences. Earliest origin and shared lineage unknown.

odia_summary: ସମ୍ମାନସୂଚକ କଥା ଶୁଣି ଆତ୍ମଗର୍ବ ବଢ଼ିବାର ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ।
english_summary: The source mocks an inflated response to an honouring address.
